title: Custom Sock Quote Brief
description: What to send when requesting a custom sock quote from Huakui: artwork, quantity, construction, materials, colours, sizes, packaging and target date.
eyebrow: Buyer resources · Start with what you have
intro: A complete technical pack is helpful, but it is not required. A logo, reference sock, product photo or simple idea is enough to begin. The clearer the first brief, the more accurately we can assess the construction, sampling route and quotation.
imageAlt: Huakui team member checking a sock during production

checklist.title: Reference or artwork
checklist.text: Send a reference sock, product photos, a logo file, an artwork file or a simple sketch. Mark the details that must stay unchanged.

checklist.title: Expected quantity
checklist.text: Tell us the estimated pairs for each style, colour and size. This lets us assess practical production and quotation options.

checklist.title: Sock type and intended use
checklist.text: For example: crew, ankle or sports sock; corporate gift, retail, teamwear or daily use. This helps define construction and performance needs.

checklist.title: Materials, colours and sizes
checklist.text: Share your preferred material direction, colour references and intended size range. If these are undecided, say so and we can discuss suitable routes.

checklist.title: Branding and special details
checklist.text: Include logo placement, jacquard, embroidery, print, cushioning, compression or other details that are important to the finished product.

checklist.title: Packaging and target date
checklist.text: Tell us whether you need labels, hangtags, belly bands, retail packaging or carton markings, plus the date you are working toward.
